papers.title: HYDRA-X: Native Unified Multimodal Models with Holistic Visual Tokenizers
papers.abstract: Holistic visual tokenizers are fundamental to unified multimodal models (UMMs) as they map diverse visual inputs into a unified representation space. In this paper, we present HYDRA-X, the first UMM that unifies image and video tokenization within a single Vision Transformer (ViT).

papers.title: Where, What, Why, and Importance: Structured Defect Grounding for Text-to-Image Feedback
papers.abstract: Despite generating increasingly photorealistic images, text-to-image (T2I) models still exhibit localized, subtle, and structurally complex failures. Diagnosing these failures requires instance-level feedback.

papers.title: Flash-GMM: A Memory-Efficient Kernel for Scalable Soft Clustering
papers.abstract: We present Flash-GMM, a fused Triton kernel for efficient computation of Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) over large-scale data in a single GPU pass. Flash-GMM achieves a 20x speedup over existing implementations.

papers.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) addresses the high inference costs of LLMs by having lightweight drafters generate candidates for large verifiers to validate in parallel.

papers.title: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations for Multimodal Image Fusion
papers.abstract: Multimodal image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a fused image that preserves rich local details while maintaining globally consistent appearance.

papers.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search
papers.abstract: Deep search requires agents to answer complex questions through multi-step web search, browsing, evidence comparison, and synthesis. TreeSeeker organizes search as branch-and-return search over tree-structured states.

papers.title: Risk Under Pressure: Compute-Aware Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Language Models
papers.abstract: Adversarial robustness evaluations of LLMs typically report attack success rate (ASR) under fixed query budgets. We propose a compute-aware evaluation framework based on FLOPs as a proxy for adversarial effort.

papers.title: Rethinking Psychometric Evaluation of LLMs: When and Why Self-Reports Predict Behavior
papers.abstract: Anticipating LLM behavioral tendencies from low-cost psychometric probes is critical for safe deployment. Recent work documented substantial SR-behavior dissociation in LLMs.

papers.title: ArogyaSutra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multimodal Medical Reasoning in Indic Languages
papers.abstract: MLLMs have shown promising reasoning capabilities in general domains, yet performance remains limited in specialized healthcare settings, especially in multilingual and low-resource scenarios.

papers.title: See What I See, Know What I Think: Dense Latent Communication Across Heterogeneous Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems communicate mostly through text, paying a lossy and expensive decode and re-encode cost. KV-cache communication is a promising alternative.

cc_updates.body: Session titles are now generated in the language of your conversation. Added footerLinksRegexes setting for regex-matched link badges. Improved Bedrock credential caching. Fixed availableModels enforcement preventing redirect to blocked models. Fixed auto mode failing on Fable 5 for organizations without Opus 4.8. Fixed hook if conditions for Read/Edit/Write tool paths. Fixed Linux sandbox symlink issue. Fixed /copy and mouse-selection copy not reaching clipboard in tmux. Fixed Remote Control model switching and disconnect notifications. Fixed /cd leaving incorrect git branch info. Fixed background sessions display issues.

Added enforceAvailableModels managed setting. When enabled, the availableModels allowlist constrains the Default model. A Default that would resolve to a disallowed model now falls back to the first allowed model. User or project settings can no longer widen a managed availableModels list.

Added wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled setting to disable mouse-wheel scroll acceleration in fullscreen mode. Fixed /model picker hiding model families and showing hardcoded Sonnet version labels. Fixed Fable 5 banner incorrectly showing for enterprise accounts. Fixed Bedrock GovCloud regions using wrong inference profile prefix. Fixed background sessions inheriting provider env from shell. Fixed 1-2 second pause on exit. Fixed git commit co-author attribution model names. Fixed /advisor pre-selection issues with blocked models.
